discovery_method: kb_gap_audit pipeline + batch L4 (initially misjudged already_fixed by generic-line collision; recalibrated tool re-flagged, manual L4 confirmed)

public_upstream.fix_subject: avformat/iamf_parse: check count_label against the available bytes (Fixes: unbounded allocation / denial of service)

oh_source.l4_evidence: iamf_parse.c:864: count_label = ffio_read_leb(pbc) then av_calloc with no remaining-bytes check; upstream diff applies clean

vulnerability.summary: IAMF mix_presentation OBU: count_label taken from stream leb128 and used directly in av_calloc without bounding to remaining input bytes — unbounded allocation DoS.
vulnerability.verification_level: runtime-verified allocation report (2026-10-17, upstream n7.1.1 ASan build, iamf_parse.c byte-identical to OH 0a0c4dd33c): count_label=0x0FFFFFFF with zero remaining payload triggers ASan allocation-size-too-big at iamf_parse.c:865 (av_calloc), allocation amount independent of remaining input; control parses clean

notes:
ffmpeg gap batch; surfaced the batch tool's generic-line false-positive mode (now fixed in l4_batch_ffmpeg.py)

form.type: 拒绝服务与配置类 / 系统拒绝服务 (DoS)
form.attachments: 附件包_CVE-2026-66037.zip, patch.diff, upstream_fix_8670835.diff, 上游修复对照.txt

trigger_conditions: IAMF mix_presentation OBU 的 count_label 为极大 leb128 值（2^32-1 量级）而实际剩余载荷远小：iamf_parse.c:864 读取后无 count_label > len - avio_tell(pbc) 校验直接 av_calloc。
attack_path: 产品用 ffmpeg 解复用/解析不可信 IAMF 音频流（媒体处理服务、文件探测）：攻击者提供构造 OBU → 巨量分配 → 内存耗尽拒绝服务。
reproduction_commands: 源级三侧对照：a) 上游 8670835 修复 diff；b) OH iamf_parse.c:864 无剩余字节校验；c) 与 n7.1.1 逐字节一致、官方清单含 7.1.1、diff git apply --check 通过。运行级路径：构造极大 count_label 的 mix_presentation OBU，ulimit -v/容器内存上限下观测瞬时 OOM。
